predictions.name: Fatigue: prompts get worse as the day goes on
predictions.rule: avg prompt score 4:15-5:15 PM at least 1 point below 1:45-2:45 PM

predictions.name: Body x work: when nbz is strained, the AI work goes worse
predictions.rule: strained prompts need >= 1.3x the turns to done, or reach 'achieved' less often (>= 5 prompts per group)

predictions.name: Loops: we get stuck more under gate pressure
predictions.rule: at least 2 of every 3 loops start after the 3:30 PM gate
